title: SearchUsers
description: The query parameters of the administrative user search, derived from identity_application::administration::SearchUsers. The `query` field is FREE TEXT and is a QUERY PARAMETER, never a SQL fragment: the repository is the only thing that may decide what it matches, and a value that could become a fragment is an injection point on an administrative endpoint.
x-serde-status: the type is IMPLEMENTED as a shape; SearchUsersQuery has no body and no route serves it
x-wire-form: the query string of GET /admin/users — limit, offset, and optionally query, status, role

query.description: Free text over display name and address. A parameter the repository binds, never a fragment. A body that gained a `where` key, or a value carrying SQL keywords, would be a finding rather than a feature.
query.x-serde-note: Option<String> with no skip_serializing_if; on a query string an absent parameter is simply absent.
query.x-test: identity_application::administration::tests::a_search_query_is_a_parameter_not_a_fragment asserts a value of "'; DROP TABLE users; --" is carried verbatim and that no 'where' key appears

limit.description: Page size. Bounded by the repository — the Rust field is a bare u32 and enforces nothing itself, so a client must not read an unbounded limit as permission to send one.

offset.description: Page offset. Bounded by the repository, same caveat as limit.

x-response: SearchUsersOutcome — { users: AdminUserRow[], has_more: boolean }. `has_more` is a BOOLEAN, not a count or a total: a console must not claim a number of users it was not told.
